questions.question: How many deaths from HIV disease were recorded among Hispanic males in 2013?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_leading_causes_of_death.csv')
sub = df[
    (df['Year'] == 2013) &
    (df['Sex'].isin(['M', 'Male'])) &
    (df['Race Ethnicity'] == 'Hispanic') &
    (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('HIV', case=False))
]
result = int(sub['Deaths'].values[0])

questions.question: In 2019, how many more deaths among non-Hispanic White men were caused by heart disease than by diabetes?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_leading_causes_of_death.csv')
heart_deaths = int(df[
    (df['Year'] == 2019) &
    (df['Sex'].isin(['M', 'Male'])) &
    (df['Race Ethnicity'] == 'Non-Hispanic White') &
    (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Heart', case=False))
]['Deaths'].values[0])
diab_deaths = int(df[
    (df['Year'] == 2019) &
    (df['Sex'].isin(['M', 'Male'])) &
    (df['Race Ethnicity'] == 'Non-Hispanic White') &
    (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Diabetes', case=False))
]['Deaths'].values[0])
result = heart_deaths - diab_deaths

questions.question: In 2021, was the age-adjusted death rate from Covid-19 higher for Hispanic males than for non-Hispanic Black females?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_leading_causes_of_death.csv')
rate_hisp = float(df[
    (df['Year'] == 2021) &
    (df['Sex'].isin(['M', 'Male'])) &
    (df['Race Ethnicity'] == 'Hispanic') &
    (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Covid', case=False))
]['Age Adjusted Death Rate'].values[0])
rate_black = float(df[
    (df['Year'] == 2021) &
    (df['Sex'].isin(['F', 'Female'])) &
    (df['Race Ethnicity'] == 'Non-Hispanic Black') &
    (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Covid', case=False))
]['Age Adjusted Death Rate'].values[0])
result = 'yes' if rate_hisp > rate_black else 'no'
